ConfigOption.description: ConfigOption (Model/Options.swift), as its encode(to:) writes it: `type` is the kind's wire name, and `options` is a flat list for one unnamed group, else the groups.

type.description: "select", "boolean", or a kind this build doesn't know, carried as itself.

ContentBlock.description: ContentBlock (ACP/ContentBlock.swift): the protocol's own block shapes, as sent. A block of a kind this build doesn't know is written back as it came, so any other `type` may arrive.

EventPattern.description: EventPattern (Model/EventPattern.swift), as its encode(to:) writes it (073): `filters` holds every filter as one string, a list joined by `|` so an older build reads it as a value that never matches, and `anyOf` holds the lists whole. Read `anyOf` over `filters`.

ToolCallContent.description: ToolCallContent (ACP/ToolCallContent.swift): the protocol's shapes, as sent. Anything else is written back as it came, so another `type` may arrive.

URLString.description: An absolute URL as text: URL in Swift.

UUID.description: Upper case, as Swift's uuidString writes it.

WireDate.description: Seconds since 2001-01-01T00:00:00Z: Date in Swift, through a plain JSONEncoder.
